levels.description:
When this skill is equipped, restores device HP over time after the device is deployed. On activation, the device loses 1 HP every 0.5 seconds, and grants the Operator in front <@ba.vup>1</> SP and a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{talent@shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</> of Nasti's Max HP.
Immediately activates the devices on the field. Stops attacking and gains a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@nasti_s2[update_shield].shield_each_hp_rate:0%}</> of her Max HP every 0.5 seconds. (Barrier cannot exceed {talent@shield_max_hp_rate:0%} of Max HP)
<@ba.rem>Gains 1 Device when skill ends</>
